deployment.commit_message:
GAP-FILL: patch-mode CV1P-S03 barge-in wire; fix function_behavior_test scalar-expect no-op; queue V3 Perception mission

HAND-AUTHORED-JUSTIFICATION for factory-staging/factory-core/sentry/behavior-
assertions.js: narrow correctness fix, no new logic. While authoring a real
function_behavior_test against hasConsent() (a function returning a plain
boolean), found the assertion silently checked nothing: `assertion.expect &&
typeof assertion.expect === 'object' ? assertion.expect : {}` collapses any
non-object expect (a boolean, a number, an array) to {}, and comparing zero
keys always "passes" -- the exact class of shape-valid-but-logically-wrong
bug this assertion type exists to prevent (per its own 2026-07-27 comment).
Fixed to compare the whole result directly via JSON.stringify when expect
isn't a plain object, without changing existing object-key-check behavior at
all.

CV1P-S03 (barge-in detection in public/overlay/lifeos-app.html): read the real
existing file first and found LifeOSVoiceChat.attach()'s config already
supports an onStart callback, invoked by both the browser SpeechRecognition
and server-Whisper paths in public/shared/lifeos-voice-chat.js the moment the
user starts speaking -- no new hook needed, just wire it. Switched to
patch_mode (small exact OLD/NEW block) rather than a full-file rewrite of a
5911-line file, applying the same lesson CV1P-S02 already proved live tonight.

BLUEPRINT/FOUNDER_PACKET/BP_PRIORITY/package.json changes are blueprint/spec
text only (SO-001 carve-out). V3 Perception mission scaffolded following the
same minimal-real-requirements path proven for V1/V2 tonight. Ports the
already-proven prototype scripts/prototype-perception-v3.mjs (27/27 tests),
importing V2's already-shipped services/evidence-fusion-service.js rather than
re-deriving fusion logic.
